text:
nisha: Quick heads-up from the design pass on the Routing Policies editor. Main pain: reordering feels unreliable on touch and keyboard. Also the preview output doesn’t explain why a rule was skipped. Screenshot + notes attached.

ben: Reordering issues confirmed. On narrow panels the drag handle overlaps the checkbox. Proposal: move handle to the far left and add mini chevrons on the right for keyboard reordering.

eli: Chevrons are good. For keyboard, support arrow keys with Space to lift and Enter to drop. Announce moves via aria-live: "Moved Rule A to position 2". Also add role="list"/"listitem" semantics so screen readers get the order.

zoe: Agree on semantics. Also suggest a visible focus ring and a 10px larger hit target for the handle. Touch users should be able to tap a long-press to enable drag mode.

nisha: Copy suggestion: change action from "Add rule" to "Create routing rule" and placeholders to "No routing rules configured". Keep labels consistent across console.

ben: Validation UX: the toast "Invalid rule" is unhelpful. Inline state should show a red pill with short text like: "Condition invalid: missing header match" and a chevron to expand more context.

eli: Edge-case: when a higher-priority rule is a full-match (catch-all), mark subsequent rules as "shadowed" with an eye-off icon. The row tooltip: "This rule is shadowed by a prior full-match and will not run." Keep the row message brief.

zoe: Regarding the preview (simulation), make two changes: 1) move the sample request selector to the top-left of the panel (users expect controls there), 2) in the result, show the exact predicate evaluation path (e.g., "host match -> header X false -> fallthrough"). This helps debugging.

aria: Accessibility: when running the preview, use aria-live polite to announce "Preview: Rule X matched for sample request Y". If none matches, announce "No rule matched the sample request". Also keyboard users should be able to step through evaluation steps with Left/Right.

ben: Micro-interaction note: animate the reordering with a short translate/scale (120-180ms). Add a ghost placeholder where the item was so orientation is preserved.

nisha: UX nit: the insertion line today is 1px and blends into the zebra background. Make it a 4px solid accent with a subtle glow.

eli: Performance nit: when many rules exist, keyboard reorder must avoid re-rendering the entire list. Use transform for motion and only update DOM order on drop.

zoe: Minor copy tweak for preview button: change "Run simulation" -> "Run preview" to match header. Also legend text: "Preview shows which routing rule a representative request matches; results are illustrative."

nisha: Action items: 1) design to provide chevron/handle mockups + insertion bar visual (zoe), 2) eng to implement keyboard lift/announce + efficient DOM motion (ben/eli), 3) aria text + SR testcases (aria). I'll file follow-up tickets.

ux-bot: created ticket RP-5912 "Priority reorder + preview explainability" https://redwood.ai/board/RP-5912

ben: I'll prototype keyboard behavior this sprint.

eli: I'll draft the aria-live strings and a quick accessibility checklist.

nisha: Thanks all, please attach any Looms of keyboard/touch flows. :rocket:

ux-bot: preview build (staging) deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/policies/preview/1860019999

nisha: end of thread.
